case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. We hold a competing offer at EUR 14.60 per unit (offer:DEMO-J1-3). We can improve our proposal to EUR 14.34 per unit, payment 45 days net, a lead time of 42 days, Incoterm EXW. Could you meet us there?

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for sharing the details of the competing offer, which we have reviewed and taken into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

To demonstrate our commitment to this partnership, we have reduced our price to EUR 15.20 per unit. This represents a highly competitive offer for the requested 45-day payment and 42-day lead time.

Under our updated Angebot, we offer a price of €15.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
